name: Granite Slingshot
description: Enters the orbit with a first stroke that leaves the weight already turning for the next.

name: Silencing Orbitband
description: Hands the turning weight from the right hand to the left and strikes from the new side.

name: Weighttip Pounce
description: Slides along the rim of the orbit and keeps the foe circling inside it.

name: Whorlgreave
description: Holds the weight in orbit before the body so that thrown stones and blades are knocked down.

name: Rumble Weightneck
description: Clips the foe with the outer rim of the orbit to open his guard for a heavier stroke.

name: Iron Meteorhead
description: Flings the spinning weight along the tangent of the orbit with a surge of qi to the full rope length.

name: Downpour Cordsplice
description: Feeds qi along the cord to keep a great orbit turning and striking at every foe around.

name: Whorlhauberk
description: Curls the orbit inward around an incoming weapon and snaps it back out at the wielder.

name: Facet Tailstone
description: Spirals the weight with massed qi in a tightening comet path that bores through a guard.

name: Rumble Plummet
description: Gathers qi in the iron through a slow orbit and releases a crushing blow through armor.

name: Gyre Maelstrom
description: Swings the weight through the qi field around the body so it arrives already carrying a trace of force.

name: Murkwhorl
description: Turns blows aside on the cord while the qi field holds its line firm.

name: Granite Reelback
description: Pivots wide inside the field and lets the weight cover the turn.

name: Verity Ropehead
description: Reads foes inside the field through the tremor of the cord as they shift their weight.

name: Plumbhauberk
description: Draws the weight and anything the cord has caught back toward the body with a pull of the field.

name: Chime Spinout
description: Flings the weight out through the field at a distant foe with a surge of qi behind it.

name: Gyrecuirass
description: Flares qi along the cord to jolt the grip of any hand or weapon it touches.

name: Pondererbarrage
description: Keeps the weight whirling through the whole qi field at one foe so that he can only guard.

name: Needling Gyre
description: Compresses the field into the weight at the instant of contact so the impact lands like a fall from a height.

name: Gyvewhorl
description: Throws the first wrap about the foe's weapon arm to begin the snare.

name: Chime Meteorhead
description: Tugs the snare once to learn how hard the foe is holding on.

name: Thornwhorl
description: Wraps two turns about the wrist and locks the hand against the body.

name: Silt Loopend
description: Steps off the line while the cord is snagged so the foe is pulled past.

name: Gust Dropweight
description: Wraps the cord around a thrusting blade and hauls its point to the ground.

name: Reverie Revolve
description: Shows an apparent slack knot to the foe and tightens it as he reaches.

name: Hoarfrost Weighttip
description: Pours qi into the loop so it snaps shut around any limb and cannot be shaken off.

name: Fastening Longrope
description: Circles a trapped foe and winds the cord until arms and weapon are bound.

name: Sanguine Slingshot
description: Wraps a leg and drags it away with a heave that throws the foe onto the weight.

name: Deed Ropehead
description: Lays a ring of looped cord across a path so that the next foe to step in is snared.

name: Unmaking Tailstone
description: Holds a foe fast in the cord and brings the weight down with massed qi in a crushing heave.

name: Revolve Torment
description: Tosses the weight high so that it hangs a moment against the sky before it falls.

name: Mightwhorl
description: Steps beneath the rising weight and watches the foe's feet for the moment to let it fall.

name: Ironponderer
description: Catches the weight at the top of its flight and swings it down into a guard.

name: Toxinplumb
description: Pulls the tether short to spoil a foe's approach just as the weight comes down.

name: Rumbleponderer
description: Dives the weight from above with qi in the cord on a path the foe cannot read.

name: Loopend Barrage
description: Bounces the fallen weight off the ground into a second blow and steps beneath it.

name: Spikewhorl
description: Brings the star-heavy weight straight down in a narrow column of qi that drives through shield and bone.

name: Silt Longrope
description: Gathers qi in a long slow throw and lets the weight plummet in a crushing fall over a wide patch of ground.

name: Sanguine Orbitband
description: Opens with a paired stroke of the weight and a trailing cord end on the same line.

name: Chime Cordsplice
description: Crosses the cord over both hands to catch a blade between the twin strands.

name: Granite Weightneck
description: Steps in a paired pace with the weight following the second foot.

name: Subduing Spinout
description: Runs the weight along two tracks at once and hides which of them will strike.

name: Rumble Reelback
description: Snaps both strands of the cord across the foe's wrist to knock the weapon aside.

name: Verityponderer
description: Reads the foe's guard from the weight's drift as a hawk reads a field from above.

name: Dropweight Maelstrom
description: Drives the weight in a basin-wide ring of qi that strikes every foe standing at its rim.

name: Torrent Weightneck
description: Turns an attack aside like a river round a stone and wraps the cord about the arm as it passes.

name: Granite Gyre
description: Dives the weight on one cord strand while the second strand pins the foe's hand.

name: Iron Weighttip
description: Sends the weight out and back along the same line and strikes twice in one motion.

name: Plummet Barrage
description: Strikes on one track with the weight and on the second with the cord in a pincer that cannot be parried together.

name: Transfixing Plummet
description: Casts the weight high with qi gathered over a slow count and lets it fall as a basin-heavy crush.

name: Remnant Revolve
description: Raises the weight above the head and holds it there like a hawk in hover before the stoop.

name: Racing Orbitband
description: Steps along the straight line of the stoop so the weight and the body arrive together.

name: Needling Tailstone
description: Rakes the end of the cord across the face like a talon as the weight swings behind.

name: Granite Longrope
description: Spreads the arms wide with the cord taut between them to screen the body like open wings.

name: Mantled Cordsplice
description: Hauls the returning weight across the body in a paired sweep that turns a cut aside.

name: Raging Dropweight
description: Plummets the weight from the height of the swing and hooks it down behind the guard.

name: Hoarfrost Meteorhead
description: Wraps the cord about the weapon hand with two quick talon turns and pulls it down.

name: Gyrehauberk
description: Cracks the cord with a sharp shriek of qi that rattles the foe's guard.

name: Rupturing Loopend
description: Stoops the weight from the top of its arc with qi in the iron and punches through a guard.

name: Lambasting Reelback Barrage
description: Pursues a fleeing foe with diving steps and the weight and strikes the moment he turns.

name: Sanguine Ropehead
description: Swings the weight in a long bending curve that comes round the guard like a river bend.

name: Aegiscable
description: Stands fast with the weight circling so that blows part and run past like a stream round a stone.

name: Silt Slingshot
description: Slips aside as supple as a reed with the cord trailing low behind the feet.

name: Gyve Tailstone
description: Draws a cord-caught limb along with a steady tug as a current draws a leaf.

name: Mayhem Meteorhead
description: Spins the cord round a weapon in a tightening whirlpool and wrenches it from the hand.

name: Mightcable
description: Breaks the weight against the foe's side and again at the other flank like two banks closing.

name: Torrent Loopend
description: Wades into the attacker's line then turns the weight against his arm as his blow passes.

name: Dismantling Revolve
description: Surges the weight outward in repeated sweeps with rising qi that flood every foe in reach.

name: Tempered Dropweight
description: Gathers qi through a slow orbit and cuts the weight through a guard like a river cutting stone.

name: Splintering Ropehead
description: Casts the weight into the wind so that the breeze bends its path round a guard.

name: Siltcable
description: Pivots to take a bearing on the foe and holds it through the next three swings.

name: Chime Weighttip
description: Holds the cord taut as a sworn line and turns blows aside along it.

name: Ponderersprint
description: Backsteps to the very edge of the footing and swings the weight to hold the foe off.

name: Lancing Reelback
description: Sweeps the cord across the line of the wind so that the weight rides it low into the knees.

name: Charter Longrope
description: Spins the weight in an open ring above the head with nothing to hem it in.

name: Cablehauberk
description: Hooks the cord on a limb and lets a pulse of qi ride the wind into a hard pull.

name: Glint Gyre
description: Releases the weight across the wind with qi that carries it past the reach of the rope.

name: Unyielding Weightneck
description: Hauls the weight back against the wind in a pull that shields the chest and cracks a close foe.

name: Glintcable
description: Gathers qi in a slow cast and lets the weight fall with the gale behind it through a guard.

name: Wrecking Daybreak Cordsplice
description: Holds the weight in a storm of orbits fed by sworn qi that strikes all who stand near.

name: Gustponderer
description: Swings the weight as the feet walk the lip of a drop where a misstep means a fall.

name: Slingshot Torment
description: Drops the weight over the shoulder to land on a foe who is leaning toward the edge.

name: Toxin Slingshot
description: Lifts the cord sharply like a gust from below and knocks a raised weapon off its line.

name: Hoarfrost Cordsplice
description: Pulls a bound foe along one fixed bearing toward the edge of the footing.

name: Toxin Spinout
description: Rings the weight about the body in the manner of wind on the plateau and throws off every approach.

name: Sanguine Reelback
description: Drives the weight into a foe at the edge so that the blow carries him off his feet.

name: Iron Dropweight
description: Binds a foe in the cord and heaves him past the edge with a qi-driven pull of the whole body.

name: Orbitband Assault
description: Pours repeated casts along one held bearing so the foe is driven back along the same line.

name: Grinding Revolve
description: Opens the sworn line with a first plain swing that sets the bearing for all that follow.

name: Tuned Meteorhead
description: Taps the weight against ground and foe to read how the bearing lies against the wind.

name: Gyrejaunt
description: Turns the shoulder into the wind and steps through so the weight trails the body.

name: Cableplating
description: Braces the cord across the body and leans against the pushing wind and the blow with it.

name: Subduing Weighttip
description: Flicks the weight along the sworn line at the foe's wrist to deny him the next move.

name: Gyveplumb
description: Sets a low plateau stance and hauls a cord-bound foe off his footing.

name: Fastening Tailstone
description: Pins the weapon arm tight against the foe's side with a qi-set turn of the sworn cord.

name: Trouncing Longrope
description: Cuts the orbit across the wind so that the weight gains speed and drives through a loose guard.

name: Crippling Weightneck
description: Throws the rope in a gust-bent loop that closes about the foe's legs as he advances.

name: Blaze Plummet
description: Reverses the held bearing in one beat and lands the weight where the foe no longer guards.

name: Iron Ropehead
description: Gathers sworn qi through a long still hold and lets the iron fall with the weight of a vow.

name: Hoarfrost Orbitband
description: Spins a qi-fed orbit about the body that turns arrows and blades from every side.
